saints.name: St. Callistus I
saints.title: Pope and Martyr
saints.shortBlurb: A former slave who rose to govern the Roman Church and gave his name to its great catacomb…
biography: Callistus began life as a slave in Rome and, according to the tradition, was once condemned to hard labour in the mines of Sardinia before regaining his freedom. Trusted by Pope Zephyrinus, he was set over the Christian cemetery on the Appian Way that still bears his name, where many of the early popes were buried.

Elected pope about the year 217, he governed the Church through fierce controversies over penance and the readmission of grave sinners, showing a mercy that drew the anger of rigorists such as Hippolytus. He is honoured as a martyr, having died about 222 in a popular tumult.
saints.knownFor: Governing the Roman Church and its catacomb cemetery.
